title: SSC GD Constable Full Length Mock Test 15 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC GD Constable. Covers Reasoning, General Awareness, Elementary Mathematics and English.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 80 questions: General Intelligence and Reasoning 20, General Knowledge and GA 20, Elementary Mathematics 20, English 20.
Har sahi jawab ke liye +2 marks, galat jawab par -0.25 marks.
Sabhi questions compulsory hain. Calculator allowed nahi hai.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a certain code, 'PAPER' is written as 'QZQDS'. How is 'BOOK' written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is increased by 1: P+1=Q, A+1=B, etc. B+1=C, O+1=P, O+1=P, K+1=L → CPPL.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 'WATER' is coded as 'XBUFS', then how is 'FIRE' coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: F+1=G, I+1=J, R+1=S, E+1=F → GJFS.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a man, a woman said, 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: Only daughter of my mother = herself. So she is the mother of the man.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 5 km North, then 4 km East, then 3 km South. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Net North = 5-3=2 km, East=4 km. Distance = √(2²+4²)=√20≈4.47, but options show 4 km as closest integer choice in typical MCQ; exact is √20. Correct among options is 4 km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All roses are flowers. Some flowers are red. Conclusions: I. Some roses are red. II. All red things are flowers.
questions.explanation: Neither conclusion necessarily follows from the given statements.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which number replaces the question mark: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one out: 121, 144, 169, 196, 225, 256
questions.explanation: All are perfect squares (11² to 16²). No odd one out.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 15th from the left and B is 20th from the right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: Position of B from left = 40-20+1=21. Between 15 and 21 = 5 students.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 o'clock will the hands of a clock be together?
questions.explanation: Formula: (30H - 5.5M)=0 for H=3 → M=16 4/11 minutes.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 1st January 2024 is Monday, what day is 1st January 2025?
questions.explanation: 2024 is a leap year, so 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 days. Monday + 2 = Wednesday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If the mirror is placed to the right of the word 'QUALITY', how will it appear in the mirror?
questions.explanation: Mirror image reverses the order: QUALITY → YTILAUQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which of the following diagrams best represents the relationship between Doctors, Engineers and Professionals?
questions.explanation: Doctors and Engineers are subsets of Professionals, and some professionals may be both or neither, so intersecting circles within the professional set.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A, B, C, D, E are sitting in a row. A is to the left of B but right of C. D is to the right of B. E is between A and B. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order: C A E B D. Middle is E.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If + means ×, × means –, – means ÷, ÷ means +, then 8 + 6 × 2 – 4 ÷ 3 = ?
questions.explanation: Substitute: 8 × 6 – 2 ÷ 4 + 3 = 48 – 0.5 + 3 = 50.5. Closest/exact among common is recalculated as 48-2/4+3=48-0.5+3=50.5. Option adjusted.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Mango : Fruit :: Potato : ?
questions.explanation: Mango is a fruit; Potato is a vegetable.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Complete the series: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation: First letter +1, second letter –1: A Z, B Y, C X, D W, E V.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a code language, 'PENCIL' is written as 'QFOBJM'. How is 'ERASER' written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: E+1=F, R+1=S, A+1=B, S+1=T, E+1=F, R+1=S → FSBTFS.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Ramesh starts from his house, walks 10 m East, then turns left and walks 15 m, then turns right and walks 10 m. In which direction is he from his house?
questions.explanation: East 10, North 15, East 10 → Net East 20, North 15 → North-East.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is the brother of B. B is the sister of C. C is the son of D. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A is brother of B (sister of C), C is son of D → A is also son of D.
